# Executive Company Strategy — 2027

Alderbrook Systems' confidential 2027 plan prioritizes expansion of the enterprise product while
maintaining sustainable operating costs. The three executive objectives are:

1. Increase enterprise recurring revenue by 28% through larger multi-year agreements.
2. Reduce customer onboarding time from 21 days to 12 days through guided automation.
3. Expand into one additional regulated industry only after completing the required compliance
   readiness review.

The board-approved planning assumption allows one major product expansion during the year. A
second expansion requires an executive review of revenue performance, support capacity, and cash
runway. These targets are planning information and must not be shared outside the executive team
until the company-wide annual plan is announced.
